lines.speaker: Hamza
lines.text: Aariz! There you are. I was just about to send someone looking for you.

lines.speaker: Hamza
lines.text: Listen, I have a small favour. A parcel needs to go across the Quarter, and my legs are not what they were.

lines.speaker: Hamza
lines.text: Pick up the parcel here, drive it to the drop-off, then come back. Five thousand rupees for your trouble.

lines.speaker: Hamza
lines.text: The drop-off is at the north end of the Quarter. The car is yours to use. Deal?

lines.speaker: Hamza
lines.text: No rush. The offer stands. Come back when you are ready.

lines.speaker: Hamza
lines.text: You did good work with that parcel, Aariz. Hamza remembers.

lines.speaker: Hamza
lines.text: The parcel is waiting. Drop-off first, then back here.

lines.speaker: Hamza
lines.text: Busy day at the workshop, Aariz. Come back later.
